chunks: And it has been narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Yahya ibn Imran al-Halabi, from Dharih, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
You pray it at night, and you pray it during the journey at night and the day, and if you wish, make it from your optional prayers.

key_terms.تُصَلِّيهَا: You pray it (referring to the specific prayer)

ai.seo_question: When and how should the Salāt al-Tasbīḥ be prayed according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the reliable chain of Ibn Abi Umayr, this hadith from Al-Kafi clarifies the temporal flexibility of Salāt al-Tasbīḥ, permitting its performance at night generally and during travel both day and night. It further establishes the jurisprudential principle that this prayer may be counted as part of one's supererogatory (nafl) prayers, highlighting its status as a recommended act of devotion rather than an obligatory duty.
